body:
This is the map Kompis.
It's a DTM Tournament map.
This map is very based on gameplay. Not details.
Very small, would say focus on skybridge.
YML, http://pastebin.com/pdrtcrPn
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/x4q6nnb35n7s7jk/Robin2.rar
Pictures? Ofcourse! http://imgur.com/a/PxOhc

 
And yes, this map already existed once, I remade it though I thought it had good gameplay.
